verdict.rationale: Neon documents running schema migrations on temporary branches so production stays untouched until changes are validated. Its MCP server exposes 'Prepare Database Migration', 'Complete Database Migration' and 'Compare database schema' tools, which together suggest a test-on-branch-then-apply flow. Nothing shows how changes reach production without locking or breakage. missing for 10: online/non-locking DDL on production, a documented branch-merge or deploy-request workflow, schema-diff/merge-back details, independent hands-on corroboration of safe migration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can ship schema changes safely — online DDL, deploy requests, or branch-and-merge workflows — without locking or breaking production

citations.quote: run safe schema migrations and query optimizations on temporary Neon branches, keeping production untouched until changes are validated
